reviews.text: Maddie and Mollie loved their Special treatment of a Bath,Flowery, and Nails Clipped. Exceptional Service had by all.

I was honestly a little uncertain about leaving my dog for grooming because I'm very protective and wanted to be sure my puppy would be well cared for. From the moment I met Tye and the front counter staff, my mind was at ease with  kindness, professionalism, and genuine love for animals. He took such great care of my puppy, and it really showed. My dog came home looking amazing, smelling fresh, and was happy and relaxed. It's obvious Tye treats every dog as if they were his own. I'm so grateful for the Staff and wonderful experience and highly recommend Smelly Dog especially Tye—to anyone looking for exceptional care for their pet!

We've been bringing our dog to Smelly Dog for over a year, and they've been consistently amazing. The staff is always friendly, professional, and takes great care of our pup. He always comes home looking and smelling great! It's clear they genuinely care about the dogs they groom. We highly recommend Smelly Dog to anyone looking for a reliable and caring groomer.
Yesette is so talented! She delivered exactly what I was hoping for when dropping our sheepdog off.
We LOVE smelly dog. They take such good care of our Aussie eggnog and Ty always does amazing with her. The staff is super friendly and experienced. Good pricing too!

I brought both my dogs, Stevie and Milo, in for bathing services. The staff was kind and professional when making the appointment. Selina did a wonderful job bathing both my pups! They came back looking fresh and clean. I would highly recommend any of their staff, as they are all both friendly and professional.
I’ve been taking my dog for over a year now! They are always so friendly and accommodating. I have a Shihtzu and Fernanda always does an amazing job with her! We love the smelly dog. :)

Over Due for a Review, But….

I’ve been taking my fur babies, Marty & Luci, to Smelly Dog for 7 + years and I’ve always had a pleasant experience. They have always had outstanding communication in answering calls, returning vm’s, texting when ready for pickup after a groom. I like that they seem to be able to fit in my fur babies, sometimes on short notice.

I will highlight my most recent experience in taking our newest addition, Lulu, for her second groom. Lulu had one previous groom here when she was 5 months old and this would be her second groom at 6 months old. We were unsure how she would react in coming in for the groom, since I know she wasn’t easy on her first go around. But, to our delight she was wagging her little nub of a tail and excited, and I relieved. We weren’t able to achieve a little top knot sitch for her on her first groom because she couldn’t sit still enough. This was something I really hoped we could achieve on this 2nd groom. So, when Ty greeted us we went over length, face shape and a top knot, please! Ty was very warm, patient and most importantly calm cuz our little Lulu can so fidgety and high energy! We felt we left her in the best hands, but due to her high energy and degree of difficulty sometimes with being still, still unsure of what to expect. When I received a ready for pickup text notification, we headed over to pick up our lil fur baby. When she was brought out and we laid eyes on her, I was beyond happy to see Ty’s work of art! She looked absolutely precious, top knot and all! We couldn’t have been more grateful to all the staff, and it’s reassuring that Lulu, telling us with her little nub, feels the same 🩷🐶

This is the only place I will ever take my dogs as I fully understand the total risks of grooming and stress on pups and have had bad experiences in the past. After not taking my dogs for awhile , the expert staff at Smelly Dog helped me come up with a game plan to help my dogs ease back into a regular grooming schedule !
I am so grateful to have found this place!!!
Thank you all so much for doing what you do and bringing real skill and experience to this industry 🙏

Excellent care and quality of service coming out of this business !!! Thorough communication of time frames , estimates, and what could and could not be accomplished with my reactive/anxious dogs.
It is so hard to find a groomer I trust as I help my pups learn to be comfortable with the grooming process, but I have finally found that in Smelly Dog !!! I feel so relieved to know my dogs will be well cared for by this amazing staff 👏

Absolutely LOVE taking my dogs here!!! This is the only grooming salon I trust , plus baked treats that my dogs go nuts for.
I’ve never had a bad experience here and my anxious dogs are well taken care of with the patience and skill of the staff at Smelly Dog, especially Trish

I couldn’t be happier with the grooming service for my German Shepherd! They did an amazing job with the deshedding—his coat looks so healthy and there’s a huge difference around the house already. His nails were trimmed perfectly, his ears are clean, and he came back smelling fresh after a great bath.

What really stood out was the care and attention they gave him. German Shepherds can be a lot to handle, but they were patient, professional, and clearly experienced. He came home calm and happy, which says everything.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality grooming and people who truly care about their dog!
I highly recommend this place. The people are super friendly and Trish is the best.

I have two French Mastiffs. If something ever happened to one of my dogs during grooming and there was no video or transparency, I’d be devastated. As an owner of two French Mastiffs large, high-risk breeds, accountability and visibility matter. This is something pet owners take very seriously.

HORRIBLE SERVICE!!! Such shameful owners,  Before you decide to bring your pet here, ask yourself: is it truly safe? What procedures are in place? Is this a business that genuinely pays attention to each client—and is the owner actively involved?

Unfortunately, my dog passed away while receiving routine grooming here. What made an already devastating situation even worse was how it was handled afterward. The owner made no real effort to follow up or respond to my concerns. The “video footage” I was told existed suddenly became “unavailable.”

I’ve been left grieving, with unanswered questions and no clarity about what actually happened to my fur baby. Based on my experience, I strongly urge you to think twice before bringing your pet here.

Shame on the owner, Jackie—this felt more about transactions than genuine care for clients and their pets.

So you guys just left the dog die, waiting for the owner? Instead of rushing the dog to an emergency VETERINARY or somewhere? SO IF, MY DOG IS UNDER YOUR CARE AND SOMETHING HAPPENS TO HIM YOU GUYS WILL JUST SIT THERE AND NOT  TAKE THE DOG ANYWHERE?.YOU GUYS JUST WAITED FOR THE DOG TO DIE? I UNDERSTAND YOU GUYS WERE DOING CP. R BUT YOU GUYS WERE WAITING FOR THE OWNER TO GET THERE. WHY DIDN'T YOU GUYS PERSONALLY RUSH HIM OR HER TO THE HOSPITAL? DID YOU REALLY JUST WAITED FOR THE DOG TO DIE THERE IN FRONT OF YOU? NOT DOING ANYTHING. IT'S SCARY BECAUSE I GO TO WORK SOMETIMES AND LEAVE MY DOG WITH YOU GUYS. FOR HOURS, IS THIS WHAT I SHOULD EXPECT?
#NOMI , DIED UNDER THEIR CARE AND THEY DIDNT RUSH HER TO THE VET THEY SAT WAITING FOR THE DOG TO DIE INSTEAD OF RUSHING HER TO THE VET.

Took my puppy for his first nail trim and drumming they were super nice to him and he loved it and he didn't even scream and cry like he usually does when I try plus their treats are amazing and he loved them for his birthday definitely come here every month or every other month is needed
My favorite place for my dog

One star only earned by the owner. Groomers were great every time, which is the reason I keep going back.
However, I am sick and tired of being sick and tired of their poorly designed and glitchy website.  I don't even want to begin talking about those issues. What took me over the top today is the fact that the owner has not repaired/replaced the card reader for payments for at least a year. Unacceptable - both for customers and staff! Takes extra time and makes line ups for pick up that much longer.
Inability to book an appointment with exact services via the website, having to call in for that, then receiving a confirmation email listing wrong services ... complete confusion, even the groomer didn't know what she was supposed to do (she did the right thing, thank goodness) simply because whatever was entered in the system at drop off was not what system sent in a confirmation email.
Too much confusion, website booking being glitchy, a year old issue with payment machine ... taken together, convinced me to look for another place.
I love the staff and my pup was taken care of well ... but those frustrations attached to every single visit? Doesn't the owner care that hers is the only business that doesn't have a working payment machine? No thank you, not any more.
Fernanda does an amazing Schnauzer job !
great staff, convenient appointment, great communication!! highly recommend for your pups needs!

This place is awsome. Everyone is knowledgeable and wants to help. I have a dog that peacock groomers have sent home never to come back. Brought her to smelly dog a got a perfect  haircut.  Dog wants to go back.  Lol

Groomers were excellent in the dog cleaning. I would advise you to get make sure and double check their verbal wording. They said dog should have de-shed done. I told them I can only do the bath I only have 90$. Their words don’t worry we will take care of it. I say I’d appreciate that since i only have 90$ . Then when charged  the total is 88$ not 63$. I said if you can’t do the bath without the de-shed I will come back when I have more money. They wanted the sell so bad they lost a returning costumer. It makes sense now why when I brought my dog he was the only dog there. Groomer did a good job but man customer service could use work. As you can see they in the photo they back out what they were stating before after review posted.

I brought my dog, Meeko, in for his first grooming appointment last Saturday at 8:30 in the morning. I was told it would take about 2-3 hours, but it ended up taking nearly 5 hours. I called twice during the day and could not get through to anyone. When I came in person, I was told there would be more delays.

I had requested a teddy bear cut, a trim around his face, and half an inch off his fur. I also provided a reference photo and was told I would be contacted if he was matted so I could decide on next steps. Instead, I was never contacted, and I was asked to pay before seeing him. When I finally received Meeko, he had been shaved down completely, which was not what I asked for. His haircut was uneven, with patches on his legs and, an uneven tail.

I reached out to the salon by email to share my concerns and did not receive any reply. The lack of communication during and after the appointment is disappointing, especially for a first visit. I’m very understanding but all I wanted was a respond.
It was my first time taking my shih tzu and I had a wonderful experience.  All the staff I interacted with were very friendly and groomer Fernanda did an amazing job!

We’ve brought our dog here several times and have never had issues in the past. In fact, we even requested the same groomer this visit because previous experiences were so positive. Unfortunately, this most recent visit was completely different and extremely disappointing.

We booked online and provided detailed grooming instructions, but when we arrived, none of that information was on file, and we had to repeat everything in person. We were quoted a 2–3 hour timeframe, but after three hours passed with no updates, we had to call ourselves — only then were we told it would take longer. Our dog was finally ready after five hours.

When we picked him up, we were required to pay before seeing him. The haircut was drastically shorter than requested, and once we got home and inspected him closely, we discovered it was extremely uneven with obvious clipper marks and patches shaved down to the skin.

Even more concerning, since the appointment our dog’s behavior has changed — he’s been clingier, more reactive to situations that never bothered him before. We’re worried something traumatizing may have happened during his time there.

We have emailed the business multiple times to express our concerns and request an explanation, but we have yet to receive any response — not even an acknowledgment. This lack of accountability and communication is unacceptable, especially from a place we trusted and had positive experiences with previously.

Sadly, we can no longer recommend this business based on this experience.
Love this place. They do a great job every time on my Lab. Highly recommend.
Today always locks amazing when I pick him up and they always have there work cut out for them best ever

Buyer beware: We stopped in yesterday to get my dog a cupcake and a cookie for her birthday. The ingredients all seemed dog friendly and fairly straight forward so we overlooked the fact that the cupcakes were in the freezer rather than fresh. Perhaps a mistake, I’m not sure how long they’ve been there.

My dog has been sick through the night with vomiting and diarrhea — we’re taking her to the vet now to make sure she does not become dehydrated.

I’m not sure how often they turnover their dog treats, so I’m going to give this place a miss going forward.

UPDATE: my dog ended up very sick with food poisoning and stayed on antibiotics for a week. I will not be returning to this place ever again.
Oh man these guys were amazing and so great with my German Shepherd!!! So glad I ran into them!
Frank :(

DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!! I don’t just not recommend this place—I strongly urge you to stay far away!

I took my 10-pound Maltipoo here, and they forgot to clean one of his ears, which led to a ear infection. I initially thought it was just a fluke, so I gave them a second chance. Big mistake.

Not only was the haircut absolutely awful, but they also nicked him in multiple places, forgot to groom two of his paws, and did such a poor job that his hair started matting the very next day. This has never happened before—I take him to the groomer every six weeks, and the only matting he ever gets is around his collar.

To make matters worse, the staff was unprofessional and dismissive when I brought up my concerns. They clearly don’t care about the well-being of the pets they groom. Save yourself the stress and take your pet somewhere that actually values their customers and their animals’ safety.

Stay away from this place at all costs!
Great staff, easy neighborhood location.

My groomer is Kim and shes awesome. She cuts my dog right every time. My dog loves her!

Still going to smelly dog after 7 years. My dog won’t go anywhere else except to smelly dog. Thank you for caring for my dog smelly dog and doing such a great job! Thank you
Great service! Great dog baths!! Highly recommend!

Jeremy was my dog groomer , did a fantastic job , was very polite and showed care and warmth towards my dog . Also let me watch , since my dog was a rescue i felt more at ease and my pooch felt more comfortable by his side . Very nice for the staff to allow me to be with my dog . Found my to go grooming place . Jeremy works only on weekends FYI . He is my guy now . By the way he had his nails trimmed and filed . Then applied cream to his dry skin on his paws  . Very pleased overall great experience .

We’ve taken our doodle pup to this groomer multiple times. Their highly recommended groomer has a packed schedule, which is clear from their posted chart. They are upfront that if it will take too long due to mats or knots, they will shave the puppy.

However, my pup, who is normally very lively, is now terrified of groomers after his experience here. Despite only having a couple of mats, he was completely shaved without any effort to work through them. He developed rashes both times, and after the second visit, the vet confirmed it was a bacterial infection caused by the grooming. The infection is severe and spread all over his body.

I would not recommend this groomer. If you’re too busy or unwilling to provide proper care, please don’t accept appointments. This place has ruined the grooming experience for my puppy.

I’ve recently had the most horrific experience at Smelly Dog. I brought my baby Simba in for his 2nd haircut as a Christmas present. I  felt very confident and explained exactly what I wanted.
Thirty minutes before picking him up, I called and asked if they could shave him by his anal area where he gets dingleberries caught on his long hair. This is how I picked him up, (refer to pic) I called and didn’t receive a call back for 3 to 4 days. I get it, it’s Christmas Time, but guess who didn’t have a nice Christmas? Simba! Then the manager Liz texted and asked for pics and further info, NEVER ONCE APOLOGIZING. She said she would get back to me! 10 plus days later! Not a word until I text her today! Wow! Ended up taking him to my own vet. Spent $75 for this Christmas present.
Oh, please note she did emphasize her offer to bring him in, and they would look at him. Not! Never, would you.! Beware!!
Kind and does a great job
This place clipped my neighbors dogs nails.......they just took care of them after they walked in and the dog ........was so proud of having her nails did....💝💝 …
They told me they no longer have self serve dog washing. Don’t waste your time if this is what you’re looking for also.
They always do a great job with my golden doodle.

Absolutely love the pup-cakes sold here! My dog loves her frozen sweet treats! I started getting them for her birthday - however it is  conveniently located off 7th so I just started picking them up for a fun outdoor treat on a warm day. 10/10
Nice staff, good tubs for self cleaning dogs
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review!
